# Reference — commands, stages, exit codes (ci-fabric 0.4.0)

Generated from the live code by `./ci docs`. If this file and the
source disagree, the source wins: regenerate and commit. The
`repository.generated` gate fails the pipeline whenever this file
drifts, so it cannot silently rot.

## Exit codes

| code | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `0` | success |
| `1` | a blocking gate failed |
| `2` | configuration or usage error |
| `3` | a required prerequisite is unavailable |
| `130` | interrupted by the user |

## Pipeline stages (canonical order)

`precheck` → `repository` → `format` → `lint` → `typecheck` → `unit` → `integration` → `contract` → `e2e` → `coverage` → `security` → `audit` → `build` → `package` → `artifact`

Packaging runs before artifact validation on purpose: the artifact
gates verify the exact bytes that would be released or deployed.

## Pipeline commands

| command | purpose | stages |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `./ci validate` | repository integrity gates | repository |
| `./ci check` | format, lint, static analysis and secret scanning | format, lint, typecheck, security |
| `./ci test` | unit, integration, contract, e2e and coverage | unit, integration, contract, e2e, coverage |
| `./ci build` | build, package and validate artifacts | build, package, artifact |

| `./ci security` | secret scan, SAST and dependency audit | security, audit |

| `./ci lint` | lint | lint |
| `./ci typecheck` | static type checking | typecheck |
| `./ci unit` | unit tests | unit |
| `./ci integration` | integration tests | integration |
| `./ci contract` | contract tests | contract |
| `./ci e2e` | end-to-end tests | e2e |
| `./ci coverage` | coverage report and threshold | coverage |

| `./ci run` | explicit stage selection | explicit `--stages`/`--skip` selection |
| `./ci release` | full pipeline plus a verified local release | the full pipeline, then a verified local release bundle |

## Profiles

| profile | required stages |
| --- | --- |
| `minimal` | `repository`, `security` |
| `standard` | `repository`, `security` |
| `strict` | `audit`, `repository`, `security` |
| `release` | `audit`, `repository`, `security` |

Required stages are BLOCKING wherever they are configured; the
`[policy].required_stages` list extends the profile's set.

## Placeholders

Available in commands and path-valued configuration keys:

`{app}`, `{artifacts}`, `{base_url}`, `{branch}`, `{deploy_id}`, `{env}`, `{logs}`, `{project}`, `{python}`, `{release_dir}`, `{reports}`, `{revision}`, `{root}`, `{run_id}`, `{short_revision}`, `{source_date_epoch}`, `{state}`, `{tmp}`, `{venv_python}`, `{version}`

`${NAME}` expands stage/deploy environment variables instead; a
missing variable is a hard error, never an empty string.
